label: Primary Index
type: an index on the document key of a keyspace; maintained asynchronously
relates_to_competency_question: What kinds of index can I create?
note: Round 16 folded in two 7.2 learn/-tree spellings, `index:primary` and `index:primary-index` - the second identical but for the prefix, which is the shadow-copy defect wave 3 exists to fix.
